name: JP Morgan Breach
desc: Attack flow on the 2014 JP Morgan breach.

acts.d: Employee interacted with phishing email on their personal computer
employee used infected personal computer to connect to the victim system through a VPN, allowing attackers to steal login credentials of the employee
Attackers used valid credentials to exploit the lack of 2-factor authentication into a web-development server
attackers used multiple zero-day attacks to gain access to various systems and move throughout the network
attackers used custom malware targeting various systems/vulnerabilities to move throughout the network
attackers collected credentials and other info that customers gave to the bank and vice versa
attackers slowly extracted gigabytes of data over the course of several months
attackers routed attacks/exfiltration through computers in several countries, including Brazil
Attackers redirected traffic to a large city in Russia
Attackers used defense evasion techniques and deleted multiple log files
Security personnel discovered the breach when a routine scan triggered an alarm for a flaw in one of their websites for charitable race sponsored by the bank
